name: harness-mods
description: This project's AI harness mods: golden-rule Stop gate, git status line, output compaction, read and screenshot guards.

plugins.name: output-compactor
plugins.description: Compacts verbose test failures (Maestro, Flutter test, Dart analyze)

plugins.name: read-guard
plugins.description: Refuses Reads of generated Dart, build output and oversized files without offset/limit

plugins.name: shot-shrink
plugins.description: Screenshot Reads over 1000px use an 800px copy
